period_note: Standalone (solo) basis, from 'Condensed Balance Sheet (Unaudited) As at 30 September 2017' (p.7) and 'Condensed Profit and Loss Account (Unaudited) For the 3rd quarter ended 30 September 2017' (p.9). IMPORTANT FINDING: despite the source PDF's own filename containing the word 'Consolidated' (raising, per this task's brief, the possibility of a consolidated-only document as seen elsewhere for this bank in 2022_Q1/2024_Q3), this document's actual cover page and internal statement titles are plain 'Condensed Interim Financial Statements'/'Condensed Balance Sheet'/'Condensed Profit and Loss Account' (no 'Consolidated' qualifier), and it DOES contain a complete Solo/Separate section (Balance Sheet p.7, Off-Balance-Sheet & NAV note p.8, P&L p.9, Statement of Changes in Equity p.10, Cash Flow p.11, ratio notes p.13-14) fully parallel to the Consolidated section (p.2-6) - this is NOT a basis-mismatch/consolidated-only quarter; Solo is used per normal project convention, unlike 2022_Q1/2024_Q3 for this bank where no solo table existed. Solo Total Property and Assets 271,304,038,098 vs Consolidated 294,866,501,754. Balance sheet identity reconciles exactly: sum of Solo asset lines (15,401,278,089+19,444,710,513+0+25,236,301,717+186,717,709,038+3,254,014,192+21,186,594,474+63,430,075) = 271,304,038,098 = Total Liabilities 246,808,525,471 + Total shareholders' equity 24,495,512,627. Equity sub-components (paid-up capital 8,552,096,940 + share premium 3,738,490,072 + statutory reserve 3,470,350,332 + dividend equalization fund 355,218,455 + revaluation reserve [Govt. securities 22,528,470 + assets 516,373,535 = 538,902,005] + retained earnings 7,840,454,823) sum to 24,495,682,627, within BDT 170,000 (<0.001%) of the reported 24,495,512,627 - rounding-level, not a data-quality concern. Income-statement items are Jan-to-Sept-2017 cumulative; the filing also separately discloses a discrete 'Quarter ended July to Sept 2017' column (Solo interest income 5,224,350,009; PAT 1,432,218,917; EPS 1.67) not recorded here. Every P&L subtotal reconciles exactly (NII = interest income - interest expense; total operating income = NII + investment income + commission + other income; profit before provisions = total operating income - opex; PBT = profit before provisions - total provision; PAT = PBT - tax). 'borrowings' and 'revaluation_reserve' are calculated sums (four liability lines; two revaluation-reserve lines respectively), matching this bank's established 2016_Q3/2017_Q1/2017_Q2 solo-filing convention. Note 3.2 (p.13) gives Separate/Solo NAV per share 28.64 (Sep 2017) vs 30.18 (Dec 2016); Notes 6.1/6.3 (p.14, solo basis) independently corroborate deposits/loans/equity and give Key Financial Ratios: AD Ratio 82.2%, ROI* 20.44%, ROE* 21.80%, ROA* 1.93%, CRAR 13.06% (*explicitly marked 'figures are annualized' - recorded here as roa_pct/roe_pct/car_pct; AD Ratio and ROI are not in the project's metric dictionary and are left out as line items, noted here for context). EPS is shown in the source as '[Previous year's/period's figure restated]' due to a 2017 stock-dividend/bonus-share issuance requiring retroactive EPS restatement per BAS 33 - a routine, expected restatement, not a data error. Dec-2016 Solo comparative (Total Property and Assets 248,605,457,497; Total shareholders' equity 21,440,771,435) matches the 2017_Q2 filing's Dec-2016 comparative exactly - no restatement detected. This is an IMAGE-based filing (no text layer, retained .txt is empty); all figures read visually from 150dpi page renders (pg-01 through pg-14).
